anchor: Preserve the approved cold-gray square-box robot identity, horizontal red-orange eye, antenna, thin line limbs and compact sword.
Use Tango only for restrained low pixel density and readable compact scale; do not copy Tango's design.
One centered gameplay pose on perfectly flat #00ff00, hard square pixels, no antialiasing, gradients, shadow, text, grid or extra pose.
Keep the complete silhouette within a virtual 26x26 area and expose clear shoulder/hip anchors for animation.
move: Exactly eight unique frames in one horizontal row on flat #00ff00.
Redraw rather than resize: only about 18-21 logical pixels from antenna to baseline, 22-25 across including sword, with uniform 13-16 screen-pixel source blocks.
Use an 8-9 logical-pixel square chassis, one-pixel limbs, 2x2 joints, a 5x2 eye recess with a 3x1 eye, and broad stable steel clusters without micro-bevels.
Animate contact-left, load-left, pass-left, push-left, contact-right, load-right, pass-right and push-right; never duplicate the closing frame.
Keep body, eye, antenna, sword arm, guard and sword as one rigid repeated module; only legs and free arm articulate.
windup: Exactly four frames in one horizontal row on flat #00ff00, at the same coarse scale and identity as move.
Show neutral commit, one-pixel backward/down draw, wide vertical brace, and maximum backward overhead coil.
Use about 18-21 logical pixels in height, an 8-9 pixel square chassis, one-pixel limbs and a fixed connected sword length.
Keep the box, eye, antenna, shoulders, hips and palette stable; never recenter around the raised sword.
dash: Exactly four frames in one horizontal row on flat #00ff00, using the same coarse robot identity.
Keep one fixed horizontal upper-body thrust module: chassis, antenna, eye, both arms, hand, guard and shortened sword never move inside the cell.
Animate launch extension, compression, opposite extension and recovery compression below the hip line only.
The final recovery pose must cross the near knee forward, reach the far toe backward-right and remain distinct from the first compression after 32x32 reduction.
No speed lines or afterimages; force comes from the horizontal sword line, trailing arm and alternating legs.
death: Exactly eight frames in one horizontal row on flat #00ff00, at the same coarse identity and block size as move.
Show active neutral, power dip, knee buckle, side slump, seated collapse, roll, almost settled and a distinct final settling hold.
Keep the square chassis, antenna and sword intact; fade the eye, fold only at existing joints, and keep sword/hand/body connected.
Use no debris, explosion, oil, gore, particles, shadow, duplicate frame or detached pixel.
